def generate(ctx, name, path):
    if name != 'policy_file':
        raise click.BadParameter(f'This Safety version only supports "policy_file" generation. "{name}" is not supported.', param_hint='name')
    
    path_obj = Path(path)
    if not path_obj.exists():
        raise click.BadParameter(f'The path "{path}" does not exist.', param_hint='path')
    
    policy_content = """# Safety Policy File
# This file is used to configure Safety's behavior.
# For more information, see https://docs.safetycli.com

version: "3.0"
"""
    
    policy_file_path = path_obj / '.safety-policy.yml'
    
    if policy_file_path.exists():
        raise click.ClickException(f"A policy file already exists in {path_obj}")
    
    try:
        policy_file_path.write_text(policy_content)
        click.echo(f"A default Safety policy file has been generated! Review the file contents in the path {path_obj} in the file: .safety-policy.yml")
    except Exception as e:
        raise click.ClickException(f"Failed to generate policy file: {str(e)}")
